requirements.Security: No credentials, roles, secrets, or access grants are owned by Batch 03.
requirements.Reliability: Future closure decisions must fail closed when evidence or ownership is missing.
requirements.Scalability: Future design must remain provider-neutral and avoid owner-specific branching.
requirements.Availability: No Phase 2 runtime availability claims are made.
requirements.Maintainability: Contracts and ownership rules must remain readable, versioned, and validator-backed.
requirements.Auditability: Every future closure decision must produce objective evidence.
requirements.Observability: Future observability is evidence-facing and must not replace Watchtower or Audit.
requirements.Performance: No runtime performance claims are made before implementation authorization.
requirements.Extensibility: New providers must be replaceable and registered before reach-in.
requirements.Interoperability: Layer interactions must use canonical owners and stable contracts.
requirements.Replaceability: Providers and integrations must remain removable without registry or runtime monopoly.
requirements.Version Evolution: Future evolution must preserve IGLS-1 change control and no silent supersession.
